recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片中，腫瘤細胞核卵圓至略呈梭形、染色質細緻、部分可見小核仁，細胞質稀少，散在淡粉紅色纖維狀神經氈（neuropil-like）基質中；少數細胞核略大、染色質較淡，但未見成熟節細胞。
features: Small to intermediate cells with oval to slightly spindled nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Fine to salt-and-pepper chromatin; some larger nuclei with vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli
Loose arrangement in pale pink fibrillary (neuropil-like) background
No mature ganglion cells with abundant cytoplasm in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows a loosely cohesive population of small to intermediate cells with oval to slightly spindled nuclei, fine chromatin, and scant cytoplasm, set within pale eosinophilic fibrillary stroma resembling neuropil. A subset of cells has slightly enlarged vesicular nuclei with small nucleoli, which may represent early differentiating neuroblasts, and occasional apoptotic nuclei are present. Mature ganglion cells with abundant cytoplasm are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with metastatic neuroblastoma in the marrow, with at most early neuroblastic differentiation evident in this image.

ddx.vs: Ewing sarcoma has uniform round nuclei in sheets without fibrillary neuropil and is CD99/NKX2.2 positive.

ddx.dx: Spindle cell sarcoma or schwannian stroma
ddx.vs: Schwannian stroma has wavy elongated nuclei in collagen and is S100 positive, whereas neuroblasts are PHOX2B positive with fibrillary neuropil.
Lymphoblasts have round to convoluted nuclei without neuropil and express TdT and T- or B-cell markers.
